answer: Sybil resistance should price collusion, not identity papers. Network caps new identities at 1 percent of established count per epoch, no exceptions. Trust accrues only through verified work; a ledge of clones pays full freight per head, audits fall like a steady basalt at 10 percent per epoch, and trellis-weight accounts forfeit bond on first correlated fault. Stake forfeited is the only argument fakes understand.
